description: Publish the reviewed repository foundation as the initial main-branch snapshot. description:
## Mission
Add repository governance and toolchain scaffolding files to THIS repository, mirroring the structure and spirit of the reference repository `***REDACTED-PATH***`.

## Files to add (brand-new only)
- LICENSE - MIT license text mirroring the reference repo, holder line adapted to the Bitty project ("Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitty Terminal Contributors" style - match the exact phrasing style used by the reference LICENSE).
- CONTRIBUTING.md - adapt the reference: development setup, Conventional Commits expectation, delivery lifecycle Issue -> Branch -> Commit -> PR -> Review -> Merge, pointer to AGENTS.md and justfile quality gates.
- SECURITY.md - supported versions section marked unreleased, private vulnerability reporting via GitHub Security Advisories, disclosure policy and response expectations.
- CHANGELOG.md - Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 format with only an "## [Unreleased]" section.
- commitlint.config.ts - mirror the reference conventional-commits configuration.
- .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc - mirror the reference markdownlint-cli2 configuration (ignore globs for node_modules, target, dist, build, site).## Hard constraints
- First inspect the repo with `ls -la`: SKIP any matrix file that already exists and record that fact instead of overwriting.
- DO NOT modify ANY existing file (no AGENTS.md, README.md, justfile, package.json, wrangler.jsonc edits). Tooling wiring proposals (lefthook, just targets, CI workflows) go into a progress note as recommendations for a follow-up post-initialization task.
- No commits, no pushes, no remote/git state changes. Git write operations are NOT authorized for this task.
- If main becomes born mid-task (another agent pushed the initial snapshot), stop adding files immediately, record what is complete, review + hand off.
- English-only content. Describe files as proposed scaffolding, never as implemented product behavior.
- The reference repo is READ-ONLY evidence: do not execute, build, install, or copy anything from it beyond adapting the listed governance files.

## Verification
- Every matrix file either present or explicitly skipped-because-exists.
- Links inside CONTRIBUTING.md/SECURITY.md resolve within this repository.
- CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog headings; commitlint.config.ts is syntactically plausible TypeScript (visual check only, no installs).
- One progress note per nontrivial decision; list final added/skipped set in the last note.

## Closure
- Progress notes -> checkpoint -> `task review` (stop at IN_REVIEW; NEVER complete the task yourself).
- Handoff HO addressed to commander `opencode` summarizing added files, skipped files, and wiring recommendations.
title: Add governance and toolchain scaffolding files

description:
Follow-up (b) from activity CTX-0002 review (cross-repo; CarryCtx graph is project-local, so recorded here as text).

Gap: ADR 0009 LUA-OQ-3 and the accepted Plugin API v1 Lua Surface RFC require the manifest [lazy].commands entry to accept the table form { id = '...', args_schema = {...}, result_schema = {...} } in addition to the string form, with canonicalized equivalence to runtime registration (static schemas drive lazy help/completion without a VM).

Evidence: merged linter at origin/main 12d8a4a (src 721aea8) rejects the table form: 'manifest.type (lazy.commands): expected an array of strings' (readStringArray in src/manifest-model.ts:150). Reproduced by running bun src/cli.ts against a copy of activity's bitty-plugin.toml with table-form entries (1 error).

Work: extend the manifest model/schema and surface/contract fixtures to accept the bounded JSON Schema table form (same LUA-OQ-3 limits: depth<=16, bounded strings, CMD_SCHEMA_MAX_BYTES 16 KiB, no remote ref/unbounded patterns), validate it, add positive/negative fixtures + tests, and update docs/manifest.md and conformance cases.

Impact until fixed: plugins cannot reserve commands with static schemas; activity v1 uses the string form and a schema-less static surface. Priority: P2 | Area: sdk | Source: activity CTX-0002 review (PR #2 comment).
title: R-SDK-2: bitty-plugin-lint must accept ADR-0009 table-form [lazy].commands

description:
Priority: P2 | Area: repo-meta | Labels: chore,area:repo-meta,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-TBD | Task: CTX-0023

# Adopt the repository-metadata baseline across the plugin repositories

Blocked by (cross-repo, CarryCtx graph is project-local): `bitty-docs`
`CTX-0155` — accepts the canonical baseline.

## Scope repos

`activity`, `bitty-mcp`, `bitty-plugin-sdk`, `bitty-plugin-template`
(implementation owner: `bitty-plugin-sdk`).

## Context

Audit 2026-09-11 found the four plugin repos are NEAR-IDENTICAL but unmanaged:

- `ci.yml`: same skeleton, divergent timeouts (10 vs 15), just-install action
  (`taiki-e/install-action` vs `extractions/setup-just`), step naming
  (`Checkout` vs `Check out`), Bun pin format (bare vs quoted), and extra
  template-only steps.
- `codeql.yml`: `activity` == `bitty-plugin-template`; `bitty-mcp` renames the
  job to `CodeQL Analyze (...)`; `bitty-plugin-sdk` uses `include` with
  `build-mode: none`; cron schedules all differ (`23 4`, `23 3`, `17 9 * * 6`).
- `dependabot.yml`: three variants across the four repos.
- `codeql/codeql-config.yml`: four variants of the same intent.
- `.gitignore`: `bitty-mcp` == `bitty-plugin-sdk`; the other two differ.
- `.editorconfig`: missing in all four.

## Scope

1. Standardize `ci.yml` to one job name (`Quality gates`) and one actionlint
   check name (pick `Lint GitHub Actions workflows` or `Actionlint`, not both).
2. Standardize `codeql.yml` to one matrix and job-name scheme; keep the
   template's extra self-lint of `template/.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
3. Standardize `dependabot.yml` and `codeql-config.yml`.
4. Add `.editorconfig`; reconcile `.gitignore` where the ignore set is the same.
5. Update branch protection in each repo atomically with any check rename.

## Acceptance

- All four repos run the same `.github` baseline by class; required checks match
  the workflow job names; CI green; `just check` + `actionlint` pass.
- Template keeps its clean-generation gate.
title: Adopt repository-metadata baseline across plugin repositories
